notes: EMBL GeneCore's public page has no prices; its fees sit on an intranet page. I found no public price lists for DKFZ, MDC or VIB Nucleomics through search. NGI Sweden's page is public, but it gives only one lane price, with no dated prior version to compare. The AVITI/Ultima additions at NGI (AVITI24 ordered Jun 2024) and the Nov 2025 harmonised cost per read are already known. I stopped after 4 tool calls.
how_to_mine: Try the Wayback Machine for dated snapshots of ngisweden.scilifelab.se/resources/price-examples/ (the page says Last Updated 24 Jun 2026) to compare the 25B lane SEK price across versions. Also try nucleomics.vib.be, the DKFZ Genomics & Proteomics Core Facility, the MDC genomics platform and the Helmholtz Munich core directly. Their price PDFs are probably in downloads sections or behind the intranet, and I did not confirm they are public.

items.label: 1B
items.claim: NGI Sweden (SciLifeLab) prices a 25B-300 lane at 32,000 SEK in its published RNA-seq example, which gives an outside-US 25B datapoint.
items.detail: The price-examples page (Last Updated 24 Jun 2026) sells NovaSeq X in 600M read-pair units: 5B = 1 unit/lane, 10B = 2 units, 25B = 5 units. One 25B-300 lane is listed at 32,000 SEK in the RNA-seq example. That is about $3.0–3.4K at roughly 9.5–10.5 SEK/USD (my conversion; the rate is an assumption). This is in line with US core 25B lane prices of $2.5–3.1K, so it shows no deep EU discount. There is no prior version to show a trend.
items.why_new: The known list has no NGI Sweden SEK lane price, only the harmonisation news.
